music_preflight.selection_policy: decode_only; no mood inference from filenames or numerical loudness; loop_end_frames_not_final_markers
music_preflight.raw_boundary_note_zh: 最大last-first差0.369481出现在Week33 HUMAN RIGHTS；这是循环接缝复听优先级，不证明已爆音，也不能认为差小就无缝。

handling_recommendations: Retain originals/hash/license; future derived editable PCM WAV48kHz24bit should retain source chain; OGG conversion does not recover original fidelity.
All spatial SFX currently stereo; audition L/R/mono before deriving mono masters; dropLeather requires a deliberate alternate channel/remix, not blind averaging.
Pre-gain then edit/fade critical source edges on derived copies; peak headroom must account for layer summing and true-peak export metering; no claim of LUFS or dBTP measured here.
SPR secondary three accepted SubHitIDs at .18/.28/.38 each get a short onset; not three full .60s sword tails.
Critical tells keep identity; use declared50percent lock, not early gain rise as a false lock; follow D12 dedupe/concurrency/40ms contact aggregation without merging damage.
Do not loop one-shots by filename; sustained charge/wing/fire voices need actual begin/end/pause/resume/cleanup binding before production.
No effect should imply hidden future enemy, successful transaction, damage, resource refill, invulnerability or Boss success before actual source receipt.
